title: December
summary: DECEM'BER, noun [Latin december from decem, ten; this being the tenth month among the early Romans, who began the year in March.] The last month in the year, in which the sun enters the tropic of Capr

inlines.v: DECEM'BER, noun [Latin december from decem, ten; this being the tenth month among the early Romans, who began the year in March.] The last month in the year, in which the sun enters the tropic of Capricorn, and makes the winter solstice.
